facts.fact: The Department of e-Government, through the PPPC with World Bank DIGMAP funding, reported the Government Data Centre in Lilongwe 77 percent complete, to consolidate government-wide systems under one roof with Blantyre as backup, due December 2024.

systems.system: Government Data Centre (Lilongwe primary, Blantyre secondary/backup)
systems.owner: Department of e-Government, Ministry of Information and Digitalization
